meta.name: faceless-explainer
meta.description: Turn arbitrary text — an article, notes, a topic, a brief — into a faceless explainer video: there is no site or footage to capture, so the visuals are invented per scene (typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz). Use for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles. Not a video built from a website (/product-launch-video — promo or tour). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将任意文本自动生成无人物讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要把文章或笔记快速变成视频内容。
copy.tagline_en: Turn any text into a faceless explainer video automatically.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to quickly turn articles or notes into video content.

howto.what: 将任意文字（文章、笔记、主题等）转化为无真人出镜的解说视频。视频画面由 AI 根据场景自动生成，包括排版、抽象图形、图表和数据可视化。
howto.when: 当你提供一段需要解释的文字，并希望将其制作成解说视频时触发。适合主题解说、概念拆解、教程、列表类内容。

say.text: 帮我用这段文章做一个解说视频。
say.note: AI 会启动流程，生成视频框架和脚本。

say.text: 把这篇笔记变成无脸解说视频。
say.note: AI 会提取内容，设计视觉风格并逐帧构建。

say.text: 用这个主题做一个概念拆解视频。
say.note: AI 会规划教学故事，生成分镜和配音。

howto.what_en: Turn arbitrary text (article, notes, topic, brief) into a faceless explainer video. Visuals are invented per scene: typography, abstract graphics, diagrams, data-viz. No real footage or website capture.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide text to be turned into an explainer video. Suitable for topic explainers, concept breakdowns, how-tos, listicles.

say_en.text: Turn this article into an explainer video.
say_en.note: AI starts the workflow, generating video framework and script.

say_en.text: Make a faceless explainer from these notes.
say_en.note: AI extracts content, designs visual style, and builds frames.

say_en.text: Create a concept breakdown video on this topic.
say_en.note: AI plans a teaching story, produces storyboard and voiceover.
